facts.text: The hotel sits on the edge of Windsor Great Park.
facts.excerpt: Located on the edge of historic Windsor Great Park, our luxury spa hotel is surrounded by 40 acres of open green space and a tranquil lake.

facts.text: The hotel is surrounded by 40 acres of open green space and a lake.
facts.excerpt: surrounded by 40 acres of open green space and a tranquil lake

facts.text: The hotel is within easy reach of Heathrow Airport and Central London.
facts.excerpt: within easy reach of Heathrow Airport and Central London

facts.text: The Luxury Two Bedroom Treehouse Suite has two ensuite bedrooms, a living room with a wood burner and kitchenette, and a private hot tub on the terrace.
facts.excerpt: They feature two ensuite bedrooms, a living room with a wood burner and kitchenette, and your own private hot tub on the terrace.

facts.text: The Signature Royal Suite has private access to the VIP spa.
facts.excerpt: Private access to our VIP spa access.

facts.text: The Eaves rooms feature a circular window.
facts.excerpt: These 25 sqm rooms feature a circular window, queen size bed, 55-inch TV, dressing table and beautiful bathroom with powerful walk in shower and dressing area

facts.text: The Luxury Two Bedroom King Suite has two individually designed en-suite bedrooms and views over the lake and adjoining parkland.
facts.excerpt: Our Deluxe Suites offer two individually designed en-suite bedrooms, a charming living area and offer stunning views over the lake and adjoining parkland.

facts.text: The spa has an indoor lap pool and a courtyard vitality pool.
facts.excerpt: Fairmont Spa & Wellness has a 25 metre Indoor Lap Pool and Courtyard Vitality Pool.

facts.text: Windsor Brasserie is a restaurant at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Savour a delicious breakfast in the restaurant or in the comfort and privacy of your room.

facts.text: The hotel offers a classic English Afternoon Tea.
facts.excerpt: Guests at Fairmont Windsor Park can indulge themselves in the memorable experience of a classic English Afternoon Tea

facts.text: The Macallan Experience pairs rare and new expressions of The Macallan whisky with food crafted by the executive chef.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your tasting with meticulously curated food pairings, crafted by Fairmont Windsor Park’s executive chef to perfectly complement the nuances of each dram.

facts.text: il Gardino is a restaurant at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: an overnight stay in one of our elegant rooms with breakfast and a three-course dinner in il Gardino.

facts.text: The hotel offers padel and scenic bike rides as outdoor activities.
facts.excerpt: Engage in invigorating games of Padel, embark on scenic bike rides and rejuvenate in our spa.

facts.text: The grounds and gardens serve as a playground for children.
facts.excerpt: Our sprawling grounds and manicured gardens provide the perfect playground for little ones to explore

facts.text: Dogs and other pets can be accommodated in a selection of rooms, subject to availability.
facts.excerpt: Yes, we can accommodate dogs and other pets in a selection of our rooms subject to availability.

facts.text: The spa facilities are not accessible before check-in or after check-out.
facts.excerpt: The spa facilitities are not accessible before check-in or after check-out.

facts.text: Heathrow Airport is about 20 minutes away by car.
facts.excerpt: London Heathrow Airport is 20 minutes by car
